physics-killer-07.title: Dokokin motsi na Newton da ra'ayin musamman na dangantaka
physics-killer-07.topic: Dokokin motsi na Newton da ra'ayin musamman na dangantaka
physics-killer-07.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-07.material: Idan aka lura daga Duniya, nisan wata tauraro shi ne shekarun haske $6$. Wani jirgin sama ya tashi daga Duniya zuwa wannan tauraro da gudu tsayayye $0.6c$ ya isa tauraron. Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, lokacin tafiya da mai lura a Duniya ya auna, da lokacin tafiya da aka auna da agogon cikin jirgin? (Gudun haske $c$ shi ne shekarar haske $1$ a shekara.)
physics-killer-07.thinking.0: Dokokin motsi na Newton da ra'ayin musamman na dangantaka
physics-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka lura daga Duniya, nisan wata tauraro shi ne shekarun haske $6$. Wani jirgin sama ya tashi daga Duniya zuwa wannan tauraro da gudu tsayayye $0.6c$ ya isa tauraron. Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, lokacin tafiya da mai lura a Duniya ya auna, da lokacin tafiya da aka auna da agogon cikin jirgin? (Gudun haske $c$ shi ne shekarar haske $1$ a shekara.)
physics-killer-07.s.s1.explain: Mai lura a Duniya: $\Delta t=\dfrac{6\text{ shekarun haske}}{0.6c}=10$ shekaru. $\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-0.6^2}=1/0.8=1.25$. Agogon jirgin yana auna tashi da isowa a wuri ɗaya, don haka lokaci ne na kansa kuma $\Delta t_0=\Delta t/\gamma=10/1.25=8$ shekaru. Idan aka ninka sai $12.5$ shekaru (amsa mara kyau ③); idan aka raba da $\gamma^2$ sai $6.4$ shekaru (amsa mara kyau ①); idan aka musanya ƙimomin biyu sai amsa mara kyau ④. (Daga mahangar jirgin, nisan ya matse zuwa $6/1.25=4.8$ shekarun haske kuma $4.8/0.6=8$ shekaru, wanda ya yi daidai.)
physics-killer-07.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-07.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
physics-killer-07.s.s1.hint.0: Lokacin da aka auna a Duniya $\Delta t=\dfrac{L}{v}$. Lokacin agogon jirgin (lokaci na kansa) $\Delta t_0$ yana bin $\Delta t=\gamma\Delta t_0$, $\gamma=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{1-(v/c)^2}}$.
